title: RNG skill-less money pit
body: Do not waste a second of your time or a dime of your money on this game. Luckily I saw through it before I got sucked into micropurchases. The game involves 0 skill, nothing you can do, good or bad, effect the outcome of any match you play. The game predetermines whether you will win or not based on a seemingly arbitrary “team strength ranking”. If you “team strength” is lower than your AI opponent, every pitch you swing connect on will go directly to defenders who (literally) appear out of mid air and stop on a dime to get you out no matter what you do or what adjustments you make. The only ways to upgrade your team strength, are play HUNDREDS (literally) of mind-numbingly easy matches (or simulate them for in game currency), or spend real life money to straight up buy better players to upgrade. No skill, all RNG, all predetermined matchups that vacillate between brain cell killing simplicity and literally impossible (without spending money). Do not waste your time.

title: Good game but has a major flaw
body: Overall this is a really fun game. It is nice to play and build up teams and players. It has a lot of fun elements. The playoffs for leveling up are ridiculous—there is no skill involved. Your same team that is playing well will lay an egg in the level-up playoffs time after time. I understand that you don’t want a cakewalk to level up, but it is all luck to win the playoff game. It doesn’t matter if you time your swings or try to really work the pitcher like you can in most of the games. In the playoffs, all of your hits are straight to defenders (they often don’t have to move at all). You have a big-time HR hitter? Not in the playoffs. You might get close, but the outfielder will catch it at the wall. If you are lucky enough to score, the opponent will more than likely score more in the very next inning (you have no ability to play pitcher and defense). You have no control over your players in much of the game, but they become very timid and forget how to run during the playoffs. If you try to steal during the playoffs, the pitcher is going to pick you off at least 75% of the time (there is no way to select steal and then cancel it). The playoffs are pure luck and must be some kind of slot machine-like system of who or when you can advance. It is possible to level up, it just may take dozens of tries (or even more than 100 on higher levels). Fun game, but completely reliant on luck and the game software allowing you to level up.

However, it’s becoming increasingly frustrating to me how the gameplay will shift depending on your prior success in the game. For example, I’m playing an event game and I have a really good team. The opposing pitcher is a 81 rating and I get 8 consecutive hits and score 7 runs. Next inning, the opposing pitcher subs to a 20 rated pitcher (basically the worst rating in the game). I proceed to go 9 up 9 down in the next 3 innings. Nothing changed with how I was playing, or the stats of my batters. How does that make any sense? If I want to score 30 runs it should absolutely be my prerogative given I’ve built a team that should be able to do it. It gets really frustrating to have that kind of success early and then can’t buy a hit the rest of the game because the game has deemed that you’ve had enough success. FIX THIS. Lastly, the playoff games are damn near impossible to win without complete luck. It took me 232 tries (I counted) to win a playoff game that gave me a 34% chance to win. MAKE. THAT. MAKE. SENSE.

title: Cool game BUT…
body: If there is no head to head or season mode (ie a 162 game season with standings and real divisions etc) what is the point? Once you reach level 39 there is nothing else to play for. Also can’t believe anyone actually spends real money on this, as you can make it all the way through without spending a penny. If there’s no enticing game mode to actually PLAY, you’re kind of just collecting baseball cards.

Honestly, this game deserves 5 stars, however there are just a few things that I care more about than the average person, so I’m giving it a 4/5. AMAZING for a free game, you can get SO far without dropping a dime on the game. I’ve yet to spend a single dollar, and I’ve enjoyed this game so much. I just wish a couple of things were different and this would genuinely be one of my favorite mobile games of all time. I wish that the team uniforms/colors were actually accurate, as well as being able to simply choose your stadium without spending money. As a die hard baseball fan, it’s really hard to have my team (Atlanta Braves) in uniforms that are Mets colored(rivals). It’s such a small thing but honestly makes me like the game a lot less than I should. I also wish you could change your batting order, not sure why this isn’t in the game as it’d be such a simple addition. If there’s anything that I said that’s inaccurate or is already in the game, please let me know!
